ev.q: Seagrass meadows rarely attract the attention that coral reefs or rainforests do

1.why: 原文只提到海草比珊瑚礁受关注少，并未比较两者衰退的严重程度，属于相关但未提及的比较，故为 NOT GIVEN。

ev.q: Although they occupy less than 0.2 per cent of the ocean floor, they are estimated to bury about 10 per cent of the carbon that is stored in marine sediments each year.

2.why: 题干 larger share of carbon burial than of area ↔ 原文 0.2% 的海底面积却埋藏约 10% 的碳，两者对比一致，故为 TRUE。

ev.q: Dredging for ports and the scarring caused by anchors and propellers remove plants directly, while warming seas have encouraged a wasting disease that can strip a meadow within weeks.

3.why: 原文并列提到疏浚和枯萎病，但没有比较哪一个危害更大，故为 NOT GIVEN。

ev.q: in most trials fewer than one in ten transplanted shoots survived the first winter storms

4.why: 题干 Most ... lasted ↔ 原文 fewer than one in ten survived，与原文相反，故为 FALSE。

ev.q: because crabs ate many seeds and strong currents buried or washed away others

5.why: 题干 poor results ↔ 原文 only about 3 per cent grew / proved disappointing；crabs ate many seeds 说明螃蟹是原因之一，故为 TRUE。

ev.q: about 30 per cent of the world's seagrass area is thought to have disappeared since the late nineteenth century

6.why: 题干 estimate of how much ... lost ↔ 原文 about 30 per cent ... is thought to have disappeared，在 A 段。

ev.q: The method was labour-intensive, it damaged the donor meadows, and in most trials fewer than one in ten transplanted shoots survived the first winter storms.

7.why: 题干 problems with an early restoration method ↔ 原文 移植成熟植株费力、损害供体草场、成活率低，在 B 段。

ev.q: diversity works like insurance: a varied population is more likely to contain some plants able to tolerate unusual conditions

8.why: 题干 genetically varied ... cope better with unusual conditions ↔ 原文 diversity works like insurance ... tolerate unusual conditions，在 E 段。

ev.q: Some governments are considering whether the carbon stored by new meadows could be sold as credits to fund such work

9.why: 题干 possible way of paying for restoration ↔ 原文 carbon ... sold as credits to fund such work，在 F 段。

ev.q: volunteers collect flowering shoots by hand from healthy meadows

10.why: 6 月志愿者从健康草场手工采集的是 flowering shoots（带花的枝条）。

ev.q: held in tanks of aerated seawater

11.why: 题干 tanks of ___ seawater ↔ 原文 tanks of aerated seawater。

ev.q: staff pass the water through fine sieves to separate them from fragments of leaf

12.why: 题干 remove leaf fragments ↔ 原文 separate them from fragments of leaf；用 fine sieves 过滤。

ev.q: The seeds are then stored in cold tanks until October

13.why: 题干 kept in ___ tanks until ... ↔ 原文 stored in cold tanks until October，原因是种子要等水温下降才发芽。
